scope: Canonical Rust product, Apple adapter, native consumers, app, and repository contracts

checks.name: rust-workspace-clippy
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- --deny warnings \
  2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/clippy.log

checks.name: rust-cli-and-apple-adapter-build
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo build --locked -p xdremux-cli \
  2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/rust-cli-build.log
swift build --product xdremux-apple-adapter \
  2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/apple-adapter-build.log
adapter="$(swift build --show-bin-path)/xdremux-apple-adapter"
test -x "$adapter"

checks.name: canonical-rust-cli-entrypoint
command: set -euo pipefail; ( set -euo pipefail; cargo build --locked -p xdremux-cli; CLI=target/debug/xdremux; $CLI --help >/dev/null; for command in inspect convert batch categorize validate; do $CLI $command --help >/dev/null; done; for command in convert batch; do help=$($CLI $command --help); print -r -- $help | grep -F -- '--oppo-compatible' >/dev/null; if print -r -- $help | grep -E -- '(^|[[:space:]])--family([=[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])--oppo-compat([=[:space:]]|$)|--oppo-camera-tail|--input-processing|--tmap-format'; then exit 1; fi; done; bash scripts/validation/check_rust_cli_smoke.sh ) 2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/rust-cli-smoke.log

checks.name: rust-native-texture-and-app-switch
command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 scripts/apple/check_texture_styles.py --skip-build \
  --output artifacts/product-integration/texture \
  2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/texture.log

checks.name: rust-component-conformance
command: set -euo pipefail; bash scripts/validation/check_classification_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_container_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_format_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_format_constructor_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_hdr_edr_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_hdr_gainmap_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_heif_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_metadata_conformance.sh; bash scripts/validation/check_motion_photo_rust_conformance.sh

checks.name: repository-policy-regressions
command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m unittest tests.validation.test_agent_completion_gate tests.validation.test_repository_layout tests.test_product_ownership tests.test_public_documentation tests.test_categorization_documentation tests.test_app_architecture tests.test_performance_design tests.test_rust_artifact_lifecycle tests.test_rust_apple_semantic_policy tests.test_apple_device_acceptance tests.test_rust_portrait_translation tests.validation.test_workflow_configuration tests.validation.test_ci_selection 2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/policy-tests.log

checks.name: macos-app-models
command:
set -euo pipefail
xcodebuild \
  -quiet \
  -project apps/macos/XDRemuxApp/XDRemuxApp.xcodeproj \
  -scheme XDRemuxApp \
  -configuration Debug \
  -derivedDataPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/xdremux-app" \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  build
xcodebuild \
  -quiet \
  -project apps/macos/XDRemuxApp/XDRemuxApp.xcodeproj \
  -scheme XDRemuxAppModelTests \
  -configuration Debug \
  -derivedDataPath "$XDREMUX_DERIVED_DATA" \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
  build
XDREMUX_CLI="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/xdremux" \
  "$XDREMUX_DERIVED_DATA/Build/Products/Debug/XDRemuxAppModelTests" \
  2>&1 | tee artifacts/product-integration/app-model.log
